concerns.text: T005 states the resource-limits module (torch.set_num_threads(2), 7 GB memory guard, 6 h watchdog — FR-008/SC-002/SC-003) is 'imported by all subsequent compute tasks', but T004 (graph feature extraction + ECFP4 for the full dataset) is a heavy compute task that runs BEFORE T005 and therefore executes outside the enforced resource limits. Either move the resource-limits setup into T001/T002 (before any heavy compute) or explicitly note that T004's compute is bounded and why it is exempt.
